response.consequence: SQL expression queries can never be parsed. Enabling the sqlExpressions feature toggle does not help. The inverted logic would also break the flag if the stub were later replaced with a real implementation.
response.explanation: enableSqlExpressions inverts the flag (`enabled := !IsEnabledGlobally(FlagSqlExpressions)`). It then returns false when that inverted value is true, and it also returns false on the fall-through path. Every path returns false, whatever the flag is set to. ReadQuery's QueryTypeSQL branch therefore always returns the error "sqlExpressions is not implemented", even when FlagSqlExpressions is enabled. The new `sql.DB` methods in pkg/expr/sql/db.go are also stubs that return "not implemented". The performance hypothesis does not hold: no input-dependent or multiplicative work was found on this path. The stubs only return errors immediately.
